title: Donald Trump loses allies after elections in Serbia and Brazil
paragraphs: The midterm elections in the United States are just around the corner: On Tuesday, November 3, American voters will choose their representatives to the US Congress. The right-wing-conservative Republican party of President Donald Trump currently has a majority in both chambers.

But in other parts of the world election results are already in. The majority of voters in both Serbia and Brazil cast their ballots for left-wing parties. Those results will not influence the midterms in the US, but the victories of the Student List in Serbia and the incumbent president, Luiz Inacio "Lula" da Silva, in Brazil are bad news for Trump all the same.
In Serbia, he has lost an important European ally in outgoing president Aleksandar Vucic. And in Brazil, the Trump camp had been hoping Flavio Bolsonaro would triumph.
